description.text: A colossal space station filled to the brim with various intricate and complex assembly structures and research facilities, the Senza Solaris is truly a monument to behold. Despite being covered in a multitide of different facilities, this station has incredibly few people present for a station of its size. There are impressive amounts of androids, machinery, and assembly lines constructing various outfits, weaponry, and space ready vessels.

spaceport.text: When you arrive at the spaceport, you are almost mesmorized by the sheer scale of the landing pads and rows among rows of factories. the spaceport and factories are incredibly well kept and open, with enough landing pads that even the largest of Navy fleets could land without hassle.  Despite the station being almost completely devoid of life, there are a surprising amount of people walking around the spaceport, mostly observing different machines and freshly made outfits and ships, talking to each other and jotting down notes.

description.text: A massive worldforge of a space station. Factories, androids, and massive assembly machines dominate the overwhelming majority of the station, with what little remains being dedicated to verious outfitters, shipyards, landing pads, and just enough housing and utility buildings to provide for the few residents of the station.

spaceport.text: At every turn you take, you feel like you are in the way of someone doing something urgent. Walking through the spaceport gives you the perpetual feeling of almost being trampled by a roaming android, tripped by a speedwalking worker, or flattened by heavy machinery. You feel you should probably head somewhere else and get out of their way, for their well being, and your own.

description.text: An assembalage of asteroids converted into a massive automated outfit and ship distribution center. Despite claims of being a newly constructed station for Solaria, there are marks along the inner walls of the station, leading one to believe that this station was used previously for something else...

spaceport.text: The spaceport is unlike any you've seen before. Exposed landing pads facing out into exposed space are placed at various heights extending out of the side of the rocky terrain of the station, with tunnels leading from the landing pads into the interior of the station. There also must be some sort of gravity and atmosphere altering technology aboard the station, seeing how you can breath and walk around a spaceport directly exposed to open space...

description.text: A desolate, but well stocked Solaria Station nonetheless. It's structure is not to dissimilar to the Senza solaria station, apart from the missing donation and research stations being replaced by freighter docking ports. There are also a notable amount of armed turrets and security cameras located throughout the station.

spaceport.text: The spaceport shares a similar ring of landing pads to Senza Solaria, with equally similar pathways leading to the trade center. Walking through the spaceport, you see various dissapointed and angry travellers, grumbling about returning from their failed attempts to sell off outfits from the nearby outfitters at hiked prices.

description.text: A solitary but large Solaria station. It's structure is notably denser looking and more fortified than some of the other Solaria stations. Being placed so far out from the rest of the galaxy, you can't help but wonder what would make Solaria build a station all the way out here.

spaceport.text: The spaceport is surprisingly unremarkable for a station of this size, but features many dozens of rows of landing pads nonetheless. Looking up from the spaceport, you can see a number of republic ships passing by overhead, with your ship picking up occaisional radio signals blipping in and out.

description.text: This station has multiple different sectors of trade centers. In atmosphere, it is very easy to become the target of one of those sectors if you attempt to land there while flying the wrong colors. Otherwise, it is fairly similar to Senza Solaria in its layout and structure.

spaceport.text: While stepping off of your ship, you notice something scurry past you. You turn around and look behind you and see a small ferret-like robot making its way towards the outer rim, melting bits of chipped-off metal and patching different sections of the damaged landing pads. Occaisionally, you can see one of them grab a small peice of an asteroid and bring it back into the station.
